meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把分叉代码升级到上游版本并保留自定义修改
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你维护上游项目的分叉,想在不丢失自定义改动的前提下完成升级。
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade your fork to upstream while keeping your custom changes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork and want to upgrade without losing your custom changes.

howto.what: 帮你把 NanoClaw 分叉版本中的个人改动记录下来,生成一份可按步骤重放的迁移指南;需要升级时,它先取干净的上游代码,再按指南把改动重新套上,避开 git 合并冲突。
howto.when: 当你想升级 NanoClaw 分支到上游,或请 Claude 先提取你的定制改动、生成迁移指南时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 NanoClaw 分支升级到上游最新版。
say.note: 会先做预检查,再按流程迁移。

say.text: 把我在这边的改动整理成一份迁移指南。
say.note: 会扫描差异并确认你的意图。

say.text: 先只提取定制,别动代码。
say.note: 改动很少时可能建议走更简单的更新。

howto.what_en: Captures the user's customizations from a NanoClaw fork into a replayable markdown migration guide; for upgrades it checks out clean upstream code and reapplies those customizations, bypassing merge conflicts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to upgrade a forked NanoClaw repo to the latest upstream, or asks to extract customizations and generate or reuse a migration guide.

say_en.text: Upgrade my NanoClaw fork to the latest upstream version.
say_en.note: Runs preflight and applies the migration flow.

say_en.text: Turn my local changes into a migration guide.
say_en.note: Scans the diff and confirms your intent.

say_en.text: Only extract my customizations for now, don't touch code.
say_en.note: Small scopes may suggest a simpler update instead.
